title: Embedding into quotient
summary: We study Bass's finiteness problem for embeddings into proper quotients. Given a commutative ring R, a reduced finitely generated R-algebra A, and an ideal $J\triangleleft A$, we ask whether an R-algebra monomorphism $A\hookrightarrow_R A/J$ forces J=0. We give affirmative answers by presenting two arguments. Also, we discuss not only in the reduced case, but also in several non-reduced cases: when R is artinian and A is finite over R; when R is zero-dimensional and A is finite projective over R; and in a series of Cohen--Macaulay settings.
